name: To Love-Ru Diary~ - Teacher
original_name: とらぶるだいあり～・てぃーちゃー
source:
A love story behind the kind, motherly blonde teacher and the protagonist.
Unable to share their true feelings properly, they still have sex every day.
What will become of their love?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ308877.html/?locale=en_US]Dlsite English[/url]]

善良、慈母般的金发老师和主角之间的爱情故事。
由于无法正确表达自己的真实感受，他们仍然每天都发生性行为。
他们的爱情将会走向何方？
